Every emitted group requires one of exactly two terminal role signs. The literal contract and every fixed bijective renaming therefore fail this necessary condition, independent of recipe resets. blockers.detail: Reference and NEW groups both end in the single END or CONTINUE glyph. Any fixed bijection preserves at-most-two terminal glyphs. Three forced terminal glyphs cannot fit; this is conditional on the fixed working atoms and whole-group correspondence. Dynamic fragment memory in general is not rejected.

Only the declared literal/fixed working-glyph binding is assessed. Transcription and a source-aware local image comparison do not establish a universal native atomic inventory, word meanings or historical use.
